# THE भु-से-छो: (The Vu-Se-Chho)

> Authentic Nepali restaurant with RC drift racing, mini construction zone, and live music in Urlabari-4, School Dada, Morang, Nepal.

## About

THE भु-से-छो: (also known as The Vu-Se-Chho) is a unique restaurant and entertainment destination located in Urlabari-4, School Dada, Morang, Nepal. It combines authentic Nepali Chulo food with RC toy car racing, an RC mini construction zone, live music, and gathering spaces.

## Core Experience

- **DRIFT** — RC drift racing track where guests can grab a controller and race
- **EAT** — Authentic Nepali Chulo food including Khaja Sets, Khana Sets, Momo, and more
- **PLAY** — Mini construction zone with RC excavators
- **LIVE** — Live music performances, especially on weekends
- **GATHER** — Party and meeting spaces for social experiences
